The packet covers: (1) 12 card types with field-level payload specs from the Round 2 design closure; (2) 3 confirmed design decisions (projections-only, BFF-source-only, prior bundles frozen); (3) required artifact workshop_card.schema.json not yet created; (4) 5 open questions for reviewer on allowed_actions shape, staleness triggers, VERS schema cross-ref approach, workshop_version_id nullability, and sequence counter alignment; (5) downstream unblock conditions for AG-FE-SW-001 through AG-FE-TR-002. PR #2070 is open. Please confirm the card type list and design decisions are consistent with the Round 2 closure, flag any dispatch blockers among the open questions, and approve or reopen.
